name: Wet & Dry Vacuum
definition: A commercial vacuum cleaner designed, within its stated configuration and limitations, to collect dry debris and/or non-hazardous liquids into a container through an airflow and filtration or liquid-separation system.
includedScope: Wet pickup and ordinary dry-debris collection where permitted by the exact machine manual
excludedScope: Hazardous-dust or explosive-atmosphere use without exact certification
Fire, hot ash, flammable-liquid or unattended flood recovery
Domestic shop vacuums and fixed central extraction systems
primaryApplications: Spill response within approved liquid limits
headline: Wet and dry vacuum types, filtration boundaries, pickup systems and buyer verification
description: This technical profile explains commercial wet/dry vacuum architecture, mode changes, representative models, specification boundaries and procurement checks without treating motor power or container size as universal performance measures.
metaDescription: Commercial wet and dry vacuum guide covering vacuum types, filtration, liquid pickup, components, representative models and procurement checks.
disclaimer: This is an independent category reference, not model-specific purchasing, hazardous-material, electrical-safety or repair advice. Confirm the current manual, exact filter and accessory configuration, local compliance and service terms before use.

keyFacts.label: Operating modes
keyFacts.value: Wet pickup, dry pickup or both, subject to exact configuration
keyFacts.evidence: Official manufacturer sources identify reviewed products as wet-and-dry vacuum cleaners and manuals define mode-specific preparation.
keyFacts.scope: Named commercial machines; filters, bags and accessories may change between modes.

keyFacts.label: Air path
keyFacts.value: Pickup tool, hose, container separation, filter and vacuum motor
keyFacts.evidence: Official manuals and brochures document hoses, tanks, filters, floats or wet filters and suction motors.
keyFacts.scope: Functional synthesis of reviewed canister machines.

keyFacts.label: Hazard boundary
keyFacts.value: Wet/dry capability does not prove hazardous-dust, combustible-dust or flammable-liquid approval
keyFacts.evidence: IEC scope and OSHA guidance distinguish commercial vacuum safety from specific hazardous-material controls.
keyFacts.scope: General procurement boundary; exact certification and local rules control.

keyFacts.label: Container and usable capacity
keyFacts.value: Nominal container volume is not automatically usable liquid volume
keyFacts.evidence: Official sources separately state container and liquid or operating capacity for selected models.

systemFlow.name: Surface pickup
systemFlow.componentFamily: Floor tool, squeegee tool or nozzle
systemFlow.role: Collects dry debris or liquid at the task surface.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer manuals list mode-specific floor tools and accessories.
systemFlow.scope: Only tools approved for the exact model and substance.

systemFlow.name: Transport
systemFlow.role: Carries material and airflow to the container.
systemFlow.evidence: Official documentation identifies hose and tube systems and maintenance checks.
systemFlow.scope: Dimensions and antistatic properties are model-specific.

systemFlow.name: Separation and storage
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources describe container capacities and wet-pickup arrangements.
systemFlow.scope: Named products; foam and liquid behavior can change usable capacity.

systemFlow.name: Motor protection and filtration
systemFlow.componentFamily: Float, wet filter, dry filter or bag
systemFlow.role: Protects the motor and filters exhaust air according to the selected mode.
systemFlow.evidence: Manuals describe float shutoff and different filter or bag configurations.
systemFlow.scope: Exact mode and filter set; no universal filter class is implied.

systemFlow.name: Airflow generation
systemFlow.role: Creates pressure difference and airflow through the pickup system.
systemFlow.evidence: Official specifications publish motor, airflow or vacuum values for named machines.
systemFlow.scope: Source metrics are not automatically comparable across methods.

variants.name: Compact single-motor canister
variants.taskScale: Spot work and smaller facility routes
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator moves a portable canister and hose
variants.spaceConstraints: Compact storage but requires cable and hose management
variants.limitations: Smaller container and accessory storage may increase stops.
variants.evidence: Tennant V-WD-9 and TASKI vacumat 22 are documented compact commercial formats.

variants.name: Medium canister
variants.taskScale: General commercial wet and dry pickup
variants.operatorRelationship: Trolley or caster-mounted canister follows the operator
variants.limitations: Container size does not determine pickup performance.
variants.evidence: Nilfisk and Kärcher publish mid-size commercial models.

variants.name: Large or dual-motor canister
variants.taskScale: Longer or heavier commercial tasks within approved duty
variants.operatorRelationship: Larger wheeled machine with hose and tools
variants.spaceConstraints: Greater mass and footprint; draining and transport need planning
variants.limitations: Additional motors do not establish suitability for hazardous substances.
variants.evidence: Kärcher NT 55/2 and TASKI vacumat 44T are documented higher-capacity or dual-motor products.

variants.name: Filter-class or application-specific configuration
variants.taskScale: Tasks requiring stated filtration or antistatic features
variants.operatorRelationship: Operational method depends on certified configuration
variants.spaceConstraints: Accessories and disposal workflow can expand the system
variants.limitations: A family name or similar appearance cannot substitute for exact certification.
variants.evidence: Official sources distinguish configurations and published filter-related features.
variants.scope: Exact product number, filter and accessory set.

performanceMetrics.name: Airflow
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Air volume moved under the manufacturer's test boundary
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: May be stated per motor, at turbine or for the machine
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Compare only compatible measurement points, units and configurations.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official specifications publish airflow for named models.

performanceMetrics.name: Vacuum or water lift
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Pressure-difference characteristic of the suction system
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Vacuum alone does not represent pickup at the floor tool or under loading.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official specifications publish vacuum values for reviewed models.

performanceMetrics.name: Container and liquid capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Supports stop, drain and handling planning
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Gross container size may differ from liquid or dust capacity
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare unlike capacity definitions.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources publish container and, for selected models, wet/dry capacity boundaries.

performanceMetrics.name: Motor input power
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Input power is not pickup efficiency or cleaning performance
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not rank machines by watts alone.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official specifications state rated or maximum input power.

performanceMetrics.name: Sound, dimensions and mass
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Supports occupied-space, transport and storage decisions
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Sound method and machine state must be matched
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Accessories and collected liquid increase operational envelope and handling load.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources publish sound, dimensional and mass data for selected models.

applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers position reviewed wet/dry vacuums for general commercial cleaning and maintenance.
applicationFit.scope: Ordinary non-hazardous material within manual limits.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: A versatile machine still needs explicit mode-change, filter and disposal procedures.
applicationFit.assessment: Select the full tool and filter system, not only the canister.
applicationFit.basis: Official product functions and accessory architecture.
applicationFit.limitations: No universal material compatibility is established.
applicationFit.buyerAction: List every intended pickup substance and obtain written configuration approval.

applicationFit.evidence: Official pages position selected models for workshop or industrial cleaning.
applicationFit.scope: Non-hazardous debris and liquid; process dusts require separate assessment.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Dust identity and ignition risk must be assessed before equipment selection.
applicationFit.assessment: A wet/dry label is not a hazardous-dust classification.
applicationFit.basis: IEC scope, OSHA guidance and manufacturer product boundaries.
applicationFit.limitations: This profile does not classify the user's dust or atmosphere.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Have a competent safety professional classify the material and location before procurement.

applicationFit.evidence: Commercial wet/dry product materials include institutional and general cleaning uses.
applicationFit.scope: Approved indoor tasks and regional electrical configuration.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Noise, cable routing, storage and cleanability should be tested in occupied routes.
applicationFit.assessment: Compact size may reduce disruption but cannot replace substance and filter checks.
applicationFit.limitations: Suitability during public occupancy is site-specific.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Run an occupied-route trial and approve cable and wet-floor controls.

applicationFit.evidence: Reviewed machines include wet-pickup configurations and liquid-handling features.
applicationFit.scope: Only non-flammable, non-hazardous liquids permitted by the exact manual.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Liquid identity, volume, temperature, foam and disposal path determine suitability.
applicationFit.assessment: Do not treat wet pickup as emergency flood or chemical-response approval.
applicationFit.basis: Mode-specific manufacturer instructions and safety boundaries.
applicationFit.limitations: No reviewed evidence supports flammable or unknown-liquid pickup.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Create an approved-liquid list and disposal method before deployment.

componentStack.name: Floor tools and nozzles
componentStack.role: Interface with dry debris, liquid or detail-cleaning surfaces.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources identify mode- and task-specific tools.
componentStack.scope: No cross-model tool compatibility is implied.

componentStack.name: Hose, tubes and couplings
componentStack.role: Carry material and airflow to the container.
componentStack.evidence: Official manuals and specifications define model-specific hose systems.

componentStack.name: Filters, bags and wet-mode protection
componentStack.role: Separate dry dust and protect the motor during wet pickup.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources distinguish filter and wet-pickup arrangements.
componentStack.scope: Family labels do not establish certification or compatibility.

componentStack.name: Container and drain system
componentStack.role: Stores collected material and enables controlled emptying.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturer sources publish container materials, capacities and emptying features.

componentStack.name: Vacuum motor and electrical system
componentStack.role: Generates airflow and supplies controls or automatic filter cleaning.
componentStack.evidence: Official specifications publish regional power and motor data.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Mixed wet and dry facility work
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Mode-change procedure and complete filter set
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming one unchanged setup is valid for every pickup mode
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official manuals describe mode-specific filters, bags or float protection.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Specify and train the complete wet and dry configurations.
procurementDecisions.basis: Filter and motor-protection arrangements change by mode.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Include mode-change instructions, accessories and consumables in acceptance training.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify filter, bag, float and tool part numbers for each approved task.

procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Treating wet/dry capability as hazardous-dust approval
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC and OSHA materials require attention to material and hazard boundaries.
procurementDecisions.scope: Commercial workplace procurement; exact local rules apply.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Classify the dust and atmosphere before selecting equipment.
procurementDecisions.basis: Combustible and hazardous dust controls are not inferred from ordinary product naming.
procurementDecisions.limitations: WCB does not classify the user's material or location.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain a competent hazard assessment and written approval for the exact machine configuration.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm filter class, antistatic system, grounding, certification and disposal workflow.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Approved liquid, usable capacity and shutoff
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Using gross tank volume as recoverable liquid capacity
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources distinguish container size and wet-pickup systems.
procurementDecisions.scope: Non-hazardous liquids permitted by the manual.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Liquid identity and safe disposal precede capacity comparison.
procurementDecisions.basis: Foam, float level and tank design affect usable volume.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No evidence supports flammable, hot or unknown liquids.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Test shutoff and draining with an approved representative liquid.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify float, wet filter, drain and pump-out limits.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Sound, cable, hose and handling envelope
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish machine dimensions and corded commercial configurations.
procurementDecisions.assessment: The operating envelope includes tools, hose, cable and collected mass.
procurementDecisions.basis: Accessories and liquid load change route and handling demands.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Site layouts and occupancy controls vary.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Trial the complete configured unit through doors, lifts, storage and drain points.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm full-tank handling mass, cable inspection and circuit protection.

engineeringChecks.reason: Combustible, toxic, hot or flammable materials can require specialized equipment or be prohibited.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Classify the material and location before requesting a quotation.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC scope and OSHA guidance define safety boundaries around commercial vacuum use and combustible dust.
engineeringChecks.scope: International standard plus US workplace guidance; local rules may differ.

engineeringChecks.reason: Dry and wet pickup can require different filters, bags and protective devices.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Verify the manual-defined setup and exact part numbers for each mode.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official documentation describes distinct filtration and wet-mode protection.

engineeringChecks.reason: Regional voltage, plug, circuit protection and wet-environment controls matter.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Match the quoted product number to the site electrical assessment.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official regional specifications publish electrical ratings.

engineeringChecks.reason: Couplings, diameter, antistatic properties and airflow are system-specific.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Require all machine, hose, tube and tool part numbers in the quotation.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources list model-specific accessory systems.
engineeringChecks.scope: No visual or dimensional assumption of interchangeability.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-69:2021
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for wet and dry vacuum cleaners, including power brush, for commercial use.
standards.evidence: IEC states the standard applies to motor-operated wet and dry vacuum cleaners intended for commercial indoor or outdoor use.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption, dust class, intended substances and exact product certification.
